name: UvToken Eco Staking pool caller-supplied pledge contract
summary: The UvTokenWallet Eco Staking pool 0x5ecfda78754ec616ed03241b4ae64a54d6705a1a pays withdrawals from a caller-supplied pledge contract address. Its withdraw function (selector 0xc81daf6e, arguments user and pledge) asks that address for the user's amount through selector 0x95b81c68 and has UVT vault 0x36f277165c8b1b80cc3418719badb1864e2687bc transfer that amount, without checking the address against the pool's registered pledges. The attacker passed its own contract, which reported 100,449,018.65 UVT, received that from the vault and sold it for 5,011.175 WBNB.
notes: Deployer setController(pool, true) (0xe0dba60f) on the vault's controller registry 0x43216378: isAvailable(pool) turns true at this block. The vault's transfer entry 0x7e39d2f8 requires isAvailable(msg.sender), so the pool could not pay out before this write. Later pool configuration, createPledge for 0x99677f42, 0x83276a4f and 0x3d7d66fb at blocks 22449376-22449382, is not needed: a debug_traceCall of withdraw from an address that never staked, with a code-overridden pledge address, succeeds.

Vault 0x36f27716 transferred exactly 100,449,018.652509565091128557 UVT (log 0x16) to attacker contract 0x99d4311f. In the same transaction the contract sold all of it: 5,052,410.919669585 UVT via the UV/USDT pair 0xb33797e8 and USDT/WBNB pair 0x16b9a828, and 95,396,607.732839968 UVT via the UV/WBNB pair 0xc7e067e4, and the EOA received 3,932.977781469900 + 1,078.197229814380 = 5,011.175011284280665818 WBNB (logs 0x21 and 0x27). That disposal moved the UVT price, so the drained UVT is valued at its realised proceeds: 5,011.175011284280665818 WBNB x 290.21 USD (DefiLlama WBNB at 1666846948). The 0.5 WBNB the attacker spent on 313.819 UVT it staked beforehand is not part of the proceeds. SlowMist reports 5,011 BNB moved to Tornado Cash (the EOA forwarded 5,011.641 BNB to 0xbc1ac845e889a8795e7f22569aa073aeb3071ef6, which made 51 Tornado router deposits). DefiLlama lists 1.5M USD.
The pool, pledge and vault contracts are unverified on BscScan; the defect is established from the anchor call trace and a state-override debug_traceCall, not from source.
